verdict.rationale: Honeycomb docs explicitly state native OTLP support over gRPC, HTTP/protobuf, and HTTP/JSON, and instruct users to send OTLP data directly if already instrumented with OpenTelemetry, plus guidance for legacy tracers via an OTel Collector. This is strong first-party documentation directly matching the story; missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of OTLP ingestion beyond vendor docs.
